activity.notes: Modern Hittite chronology conventionally places Mursili II's reign at about 1321-1295 BCE. ATLAS keeps both boundaries approximate rather than presenting the reconstructed absolute chronology as exact.

sources.title: The Reign of Mursili II (c.1321–1295) — The Kingdom of the Hittites
sources.citation_text: Trevor Bryce's Oxford history treats the reign of Mursili II as approximately 1321 to 1295 BCE.
